page.title: Filin gwaji
page.lead: Yi wa samfurin yanke shawara tambayoyi masu nau’i game da kowane rubutu ko JSON, ka sami amsoshi da aka daidaita a zagaye ɗaya — ba tare da rubutun da aka ƙirƙira ba.

state.label: Yanayi
state.placeholder: Saƙo, tikiti, takarda ko tattaunawar da za a yanke shawara a kai

help.text: Ana aika shi daidai yadda aka rubuta.
help.json: Ana aika abu a matsayin JSON, maɓallai a jerin da aka rubuta su. Ana karanta jeri a matsayin tattaunawa kuma ana rage shi daga farko, don sabbin maganganu su rage.

questions.label: Tambayoyi
questions.help: Abu na JSON wanda maɓallansa lambobin tantance tambayoyi ne. Kowace tambaya na da nau’i, umarni kuma — ga choice da score — ma’auni.

add.label: Ƙara tambaya
add.invalidJson: Gyara tambayoyin tukuna: ƙara ɗaya zai maye gurbin rubutun da ba abu na JSON mai inganci ba ne.

noul.title: Eh ko a’a
noul.desc: Shin magana gaskiya ce? Yana amsawa da yiwuwa.

score.title: Ma’aunin tantancewa
score.desc: Yana ba da maki bisa matakai da aka jera. Yana amsawa da matakin da ake tsammani.

choice.title: Zaɓi daga da yawa
choice.desc: Yana zaɓar ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukanka masu lakabi.

checkpoint.label: Checkpoint
checkpoint.help: “Kai tsaye” yana zaɓar checkpoint bisa harshen yanayin. Idan ka zaɓi ɗaya, duk buƙatu za su je gare shi, ko da wane harshe.

issues.title: Matsalolin da za a gyara
issues.stateNull: Yanayi ba zai iya zama null ba.
issues.stateJson: Yanayin ba JSON mai inganci ba ne: {{detail}} (layi {{line}}, shafi {{column}}).
issues.questionsJson: Tambayoyin ba JSON mai inganci ba ne: {{detail}} (layi {{line}}, shafi {{column}}).
issues.questionsNotObject: Dole tambayoyi su zama abu na JSON wanda maɓallansa lambobin tantance tambayoyi ne.
issues.tooManyQuestions: Tambayoyi {{max}} a mafi yawa a kowace buƙata.
issues.tooManyTotal: Zaɓuɓɓuka {{max}} a mafi yawa gaba ɗaya a duk tambayoyi.
issues.badType: “{{id}}”: dole type ya zama choice, score ko noul.
issues.labelsOnlyNoul: “{{id}}”: labels ya shafi tambayoyin noul kawai.
issues.choiceNeedsCriteria: “{{id}}”: tambayar choice na buƙatar ma’auni — abu na zaɓuɓɓuka ko jerin lakabai.
issues.labelNotScalar: “{{id}}”: dole kowane lakabi ya zama rubutu, lamba ko true/false.
issues.duplicateLabel: “{{id}}”: lakabin {{label}} ya bayyana sau biyu (1, 1.0 da true ana ƙidaya su a matsayin lakabi ɗaya).
issues.scoreNeedsLevels: “{{id}}”: tambayar score na buƙatar ma’auni a matsayin jerin matakai, daga mafi ƙasa.
issues.nullLevel: “{{id}}”: mataki ba zai iya zama null ba.
issues.noulCriteria: “{{id}}”: ma’aunin noul na iya bayyana true da false kawai.
issues.noulLabels: “{{id}}”: labels na buƙatar rubutu daban-daban ga true da false.
issues.badBudget: Dole {{name}} ya zama cikakkiyar lamba daga 1 zuwa {{max}}.

examples.intro: Zaɓi misali don loda shi a cikin masu gyara. Ba za a aika komai ba sai ka danna Gudanar.

review.title: Ya gamsu ko a’a?
review.blurb: Tambayoyin eh/a’a. Lakabai suna sake sunan amsar, ma’auni kuma suna faɗin abin da ake la’akari.

bugReport.title: Tantance rahoton kuskure
bugReport.blurb: Ma’aunin matakai da aka jera. Amsar ita ce matakin da ake tsammani, wanda zai iya faɗa tsakanin biyu.

helpdesk.title: Tura buƙata zuwa teburin taimako
helpdesk.blurb: Zaɓuɓɓuka da aka bayyana. Suna raba kasafin token ɗaya, don haka dogayen jeri suna matse juna.

triage.title: Rarraba tikitin tallafi
triage.blurb: Ƙungiya, gaggawa da mayar da kuɗi — tambayoyi uku game da saƙo ɗaya a buƙata ɗaya.

resume.title: Tace takardun CV
resume.blurb: Matakin ƙwarewa, fasahar da ake buƙata da jagoranci, da aka karanta daga CV.

guardrails.title: Shingen kariya na LLM
guardrails.blurb: Gano ƙoƙarin jailbreak kuma tantance lahani kafin samfuri ya amsa.

moderation.title: Kula da abun ciki
moderation.blurb: Suka mai tsanani ba cin zarafi ba ne: bambanta su.

phishing.title: Imel na zamba
phishing.blurb: Yanayin JSON: imel gaba ɗaya, tare da mai aikawa da maudu’i.

german.title: Jamusanci
german.blurb: Rubutun Latin, amma ba Turanci ba: ana tura shi bisa harshe, ba rubutu ba.

share.tooLong: Wannan buƙatar ta yi tsayi da yawa don a raba ta a matsayin hanyar haɗi. Maimakon haka kwafi JSON na buƙatar.
share.inAddressBar: Ba a iya kwafa kai tsaye ba: hanyar haɗin tana cikin sandar adireshi.

code.fixFirst: Gyara matsalolin buƙatar don ganin ta a matsayin lamba.
code.jev: Kowane abokin ciniki na TypeSafe Jev yana aiki ba tare da canji ba: kawai ka nuna shi nan. Sunan samfurin da wannan sabis bai sani ba zai koma helexa/one.
code.key: Buƙatu ba tare da maɓalli ba suna aiki cikin iyakar jama’a. Don ƙari, ƙirƙiri maɓallin API kuma ka saita HELEXA_API_KEY.

results.empty: Gudanar da buƙata don ganin amsoshi a nan.
results.confidenceHelp: Tabbacin amsa shi ne yiwuwar amsar da aka zaɓa — lambar da aka daidaita da ake sa iyaka a kanta. Tabbaci yana auna yadda rarrabuwar gaba ɗaya take a bayyane (1 − entropy da aka daidaita; a eh/a’a, yiwuwa mafi girma) kuma ba a kwatanta shi tsakanin nau’o’in tambayoyi.
results.collapsed: An rage wasu zaɓuɓɓuka zuwa token iri ɗaya don su shiga kasafin, don haka samfurin bai iya bambanta su ba. Rage rubutun zaɓuɓɓuka ko ka yi amfani da kaɗan.

routing.title: Hanyar tura
routing.pinned: Buƙatar ta ambaci wannan checkpoint, don haka an tsallake gano harshe.

usage.title: Amfani da lokaci
usage.help: Ana biyan shawarwari da token na shigarwa. Ana ɓoye kowace tambaya tare da yanayin, don haka kowace ƙarin tambaya game da dogon yanayi tana sake biyan wannan yanayin.

errors.retryIn: Za ka iya sake gwadawa bayan daƙiƙa {{seconds}}.
errors.retryNow: Za ka iya sake gwadawa yanzu.
errors.rateLimitNote: Wurin shiga na jama’a yana karɓar buƙatu 10 a minti daga kowane adireshi. Sake gwadawa bayan minti ɗaya.

validation.title: Sabar ta ƙi buƙatar
validation.help: Gyara matsalar da ke ƙasa ka sake gudanarwa.

too_large.title: Buƙatar ta yi girma da yawa
too_large.help: Ta wuce ɗaya daga cikin iyakokin sabar.

rate_limited.title: Buƙatu sun yi yawa
rate_limited.help: Sabis yana iyakance sau nawa wannan adireshi zai iya tambaya.

unavailable.title: Sabis yana cikin aiki
unavailable.help: Samfurin yana cikin aiki ko ana sake kunna shi.

not_found.title: Babu samfurin yanke shawara da ake da shi
not_found.help: A yanzu sabis ba shi da samfurin da zai iya amsawa.

server.title: Sabis ya gaza
server.help: Wani abu ya lalace a sabar. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.

network.title: Ba a iya isa ga sabis ba

timeout.title: Lokacin buƙatar ya ƙare
timeout.help: Amsa ba ta iso a kan lokaci ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.

cancelled.title: An soke
cancelled.help: An dakatar da buƙatar kafin ta ƙare.

bad_response.title: Amsar da ba a iya karantawa
bad_response.help: Sabis ya amsa da wani abu da ba shawara ba ne.
